# KeyLedger Templates

> Free landlord and real estate investor guides, a free online rental cash flow calculator, and paid spreadsheet templates for Excel and Google Sheets sold on Etsy.

Shop: https://www.etsy.com/shop/KeyLedgerTemplates

## Guides

- [How to Track Rental Income and Expenses for Schedule E (A Simple System for Small Landlords)](https://golf4life27.github.io/track-rental-income-expenses-schedule-e/): A simple, year-round system for tracking rental income and expenses by Schedule E line, so tax time takes an hour instead of a weekend. Includes the full category list.
- [How to Calculate Rental Property Cash Flow (With a Worked Example)](https://golf4life27.github.io/rental-property-cash-flow-calculation/): Step-by-step rental property cash flow calculation with a real worked example: vacancy, management, repairs, CapEx, taxes, insurance and the mortgage. Plus cap rate and cash-on-cash.
- [BRRRR Calculator Walkthrough: How Much Cash Do You Really Get Back at Refinance?](https://golf4life27.github.io/brrrr-calculator-walkthrough/): A line-by-line BRRRR example: purchase, hard money, rehab, holding costs, cash-out refinance, cash left in the deal, post-refi cash flow and the max price for a full cash-out.
- [The 70% Rule and MAO: How to Calculate a Max Offer on a Fix and Flip](https://golf4life27.github.io/70-percent-rule-mao-fix-and-flip/): How the 70% rule works, how to calculate maximum allowable offer (MAO) from ARV and repairs, and why a full-cost flip budget plus a stress test beats the rule of thumb.
- [How Much Should Landlords Save for Repairs and CapEx? A Simple Reserve Formula](https://golf4life27.github.io/capex-reserves-rental-property/): Percent-of-rent rules vs. an itemized CapEx reserve: how to calculate how much to set aside each month for roofs, HVAC, water heaters and more, with a worked example.
- [Airbnb Host Bookkeeping: How to Track Income, Expenses, Occupancy and Payouts in One Spreadsheet](https://golf4life27.github.io/airbnb-host-bookkeeping-spreadsheet/): A simple Airbnb host bookkeeping system: log every booking and expense, then see occupancy, ADR, RevPAR and net profit by month. Built for short-term rental hosts on Excel or Google Sheets.

## Free tools

- [Free Rental Cash Flow Calculator](https://golf4life27.github.io/free-rental-cash-flow-calculator/): online calculator + free .xlsx; cash flow, NOI, cap rate, cash-on-cash, DSCR, 1% rule
- [Airbnb Profit Calculator](https://golf4life27.github.io/airbnb-profit-calculator/): Free Airbnb profit calculator: enter nightly rate, occupancy, fees and costs to see monthly net profit, break-even occupancy and cash-on-cash return.
- [Prorated Rent Calculator](https://golf4life27.github.io/prorated-rent-calculator/): Free prorated rent calculator for move-in or move-out: see partial-month rent by actual days, 30-day month and 365-day year, plus the total due at move-in.
- [Rent Increase Calculator](https://golf4life27.github.io/rent-increase-calculator/): Free rent increase calculator: turn a percent into the new monthly rent, or a new rent into a percent, and see the yearly cost and where rent lands after several years.
- [Cap Rate Calculator](https://golf4life27.github.io/cap-rate-calculator/): Free cap rate calculator for rental property: build net operating income from rent, vacancy and expenses, get the cap rate on your price, and see what the property is worth at your target cap rate.
- [Cash-on-Cash Return Calculator](https://golf4life27.github.io/cash-on-cash-return-calculator/): Free cash-on-cash return calculator for rental property: enter the price, loan, rent and expenses to get the mortgage payment, yearly cash flow, cash-on-cash return, return with principal paydown, and the most you can pay to hit your target return.
- [DSCR Calculator](https://golf4life27.github.io/dscr-calculator/): Free DSCR calculator for rental property: enter the rent, loan, taxes and insurance to get the monthly PITIA, the lender-style DSCR (rent ÷ PITIA), the NOI-based DSCR, the rent you need, and the largest loan and price that still hit your target DSCR. Amortizing or interest-only.
- [Security Deposit Deduction Calculator](https://golf4life27.github.io/security-deposit-deduction-calculator/): Free security deposit deduction calculator: add up unpaid rent, cleaning, repairs and other charges, include any deposit interest, and see the refund due or the balance the tenant still owes.
- [Fix and Flip Calculator](https://golf4life27.github.io/fix-and-flip-profit-calculator/): Free fix and flip calculator: enter the purchase price, rehab, ARV, hard money loan, holding and selling costs to get total project cost, net profit, return on your cash, annualized ROI, break-even sale price, the 70% rule offer, and the most you can pay to hit your profit target.
- [BRRRR Calculator](https://golf4life27.github.io/brrrr-calculator/): Free BRRRR calculator: enter the purchase, short-term loan, rehab, holding costs, ARV, refinance terms and rent to get total project cost, cash out at refinance, cash left in the deal, equity, post-refinance cash flow, cash-on-cash return, DSCR, and the highest price that still returns all your cash.
- [Airbnb vs Long-Term Rental Calculator](https://golf4life27.github.io/airbnb-vs-long-term-rental-calculator/): Free Airbnb vs long-term rental calculator: run one property both ways to compare monthly net profit, cash-on-cash return, the occupancy the Airbnb needs just to match a 12-month lease, the rent that ties it, and how long the furniture takes to pay back.
